messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + streaming disconnects detected for /v1/streams — 5xx rate 4.8% (baseline ~0.2%), streaming disconnects up 18% in last 5m. Pager: eng-runtime oncall @alex. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/services/streams/overview

alex (oncall): Ack, I'm on it. Moving triage here. Who's able to look at proxy logs? Any customer pages? :rotating_light:

priya: I have samples — seeing a lot of `upstream reset` and `client cancelled stream` from stream-proxy. Example log snippet:```ERROR 2026-03-14T02:45:23Z stream-proxy worker=3 upstream reset: ECONNRESET from model-worker-3 (request_id=abcd1234)
WARN  2026-03-14T02:45:24Z stream-proxy client cancelled write:  broken pipe (client=10.4.5.7)```

matt: Grepping for "chunked" shows repeated `chunked encoding error: truncated` around the same time window. Could be proxy_buffer or ngx_http chunking edge case. Running `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=stream-proxy --since=10m` now.

samira: Quick mitigation idea: flip heavy customers to the non-streaming fallback route for a short window (returns full payload instead of streaming chunks). Can we toggle 10% traffic while we investigate? That will reduce long-lived connections.

alex (oncall): Good plan. priya, can you patch replicas first so we reduce per-proxy load? matt, look at keepalive settings. jordan, any concerns about disabling streaming for some customers?

priya: Patch ready to scale: `kubectl -n inference patch deployment stream-proxy --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/replicas","value":8}]'` Also recommending nginx tweaks: `proxy_read_timeout 90s; proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off;`

jordan: Also suggest temporarily disabling HTTP/2 multiplexing at the edge for streaming endpoints — some client stacks abort streams unexpectedly when multiplexing is under load. I can roll that as a canary.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: stream-proxy replicas -> 8 (canary 2). CI checks: passed.

alex (oncall): Samira, start customer outreach for top impacted accounts. Matt/priya, coordinate on infra changes and watch the metrics. Root incident timestamp: 1779012345.

samira: Noted. CS pinged top 5 customers (AcmeChat, HelpDesk.ai, Botcorp). Created incident note and RFO channel.

priya: After scaling + nginx config canary: 5xx rate dropped to 1.1%, streaming disconnects now 6% in last 5m. Holding for 15m to confirm.

matt: Early root-cause hypothesis: proxy buffer exhaustion + head-of-line blocking for long-lived streams -> upstream connection resets when workers are saturated. Follow-up: add chunked-encoding timeouts, surface chunk buffer utilization in metrics. I'll open a ticket with proposed infra changes.

alex (oncall): Handoff: I'll be handing to night oncall @samira in 30m. Conditions for re-paging: 5xx > 2% sustained or streaming disconnects > 10%. Samira, you're incident commander after handoff.

samira: Copy — will watch for 30m, escalate if thresholds hit. Creating follow-up tasks: `RT: add buffer metrics`, `RT: validate HTTP/2 edge behavior`, `RT: update runbook with fallback toggle`.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: severity=high -> mitigated. Ops playbook link: https://playbooks.redwood.local/streaming-disconnects. Please file postmortem with timeline and customer impact details. :white_check_mark:
